decisions.label: clear
decisions.evidence: Please be assured that we will keep the communications to a minimum and you will have an option to block any communication from us if your subscriptions are cancelled. Please be aware that we reserve the right to notify our subscribers of any information that affects the status of current subscriptions.
decisions.rationale: The policy states that communications will be kept to a minimum and provides an option to block communications, but does not specify an end date for retaining financial data.
